NO CURRENCY YEAR IS GIVEN ANYWHERE. Table 1's capital and operating costs are in EUR and three of its modernised-Soderberg components are in USD, with no base year for either. 2012_EUR has been assumed from the publication date for the two roster cost rows, which is a judgement and is flagged on those rows; the retrofit ladder keeps the bare EUR and USD it was printed in.

Table 1's environmental block has four columns and three of its seven rows are missing a value, but not the same one - CO2 and PFC skip Modified Soderberg, HF skips Vertical Stud Soderberg, and PAH skips PreBake-with-scrubber. Read left to right the values shift a column and land on the wrong technology. Resolved from the PDF's x-coordinates.

Four. (1) The page carrying Table 1 is headed 'Technology Brief I05 - February 2012' where every other page says I10 - March 2012. (2) Both p.1 and p.3 give secondary aluminium's salt slag as 'up to 500 TONNES per tonne of aluminium'; kg/t is the only possible reading and is what is recorded. (3) p.1 puts the Prebake share at 63% in 1990 rising to 90% in 2010 while p.3 puts it at 33% rising to 85%. (4) p.1 says secondary aluminium uses 'less than 5%' of primary's energy, but Table 1's own 2-4.7 GJ/t against primary's 49-63 GJ/t is 3-10%.

Table 1's technical block is per tonne of ALUMINIUM throughout - including the bauxite and alumina rows, which are not per tonne of alumina. The two exceptions are cast house energy (per tonne of MELTED aluminium) and red mud (per tonne of Al2O3). Mixing them without converting is the easiest mistake to make with this table.

Changes against the repo copy: the Prebake cell's 960 degC temperature-output row moved to _process-temperatures.csv - it is the bath (process) temperature, not a delivered-heat temperature. Nothing else changed.
